introduction_markdown: Épreuve à choix multiples (Special Bilingual Education French 1, juin 2022). Répondez à toutes les 50 questions ; chaque question vaut un point. Quatre alternatives (A, B, C, D) sont proposées, une seule est correcte. Les téléphones mobiles sont strictement interdits dans la salle de composition. Durée : une heure trente minutes.
enonce_intro_markdown: **Questions à choix multiples** - choisissez la seule bonne réponse, A, B, C ou D.
incertitudes: Scan photocopié avec filigrane : tout est lisible ; les blancs imprimés sont écrits « ____ ».

Q18, Q24, Q43, Q46, Q48, Q49 converties en questions ouvertes : clé non établissable avec certitude (œuvre de Jean Pliya non relue ici ; date de modification de l'hymne ; vocabulaire du programme camerounais d'EPS : académique/léotard, aire de lancer, numérotation des virages du 200 m, groupes d'éléments A-D).

Clés retenues mais discutables : Q10 (tamtam / tambour), Q15 (de large / de largeur, les deux corrects en français), Q21 (authentique / officiel), Q31 (gaz carbonique / chlorofluorocarbure, les deux sont des gaz à effet de serre), Q27 (trois sessions), Q32 (1949), Q42 (dix cm), Q45 (renversements).
Q19 et Q20 : le poème est imprimé en deux colonnes ; il est lu comme trois strophes de cinq vers (clé quintil, vers de quatre syllabes). Le « p » minuscule de « par un soupir » est conservé.
Q14, Q15, Q16 sont des questions de traduction de l'anglais vers le français (thème traduction vers le francais).
Corrigés rédigés sans corrigé officiel, notamment les faits civiques et sportifs (Q22-Q50) : à faire relire.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**FRANÇAIS INTENSIF**

Si je porte mon ____ ensemble le jour de Noël, tout le monde l’admirera.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Ensemble" is a masculine noun beginning with a vowel sound, so the adjective takes its special masculine form "bel" (beau becomes bel before a vowel or a mute h). "Beau" is used before a consonant, "belle" is feminine, and "bon" changes the meaning (good). Rule: beau, bel (before a vowel), belle. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Les élèves têtus ____ les salles de classes tous les vendredis après les cours.
questions.corrige_markdown: The subject "les élèves" is third person plural and the action is a habit ("tous les vendredis"), so the present tense "nettoient" is correct. "Nettoyait" is singular, "nettoies" and "nettoyais" are second or first person singular. Rule: verbs in -oyer change y to i before a mute e, and the 3rd person plural ends in -ent. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: L’internet nous permet de transmettre tout type de données ____ rapidement.
questions.corrige_markdown: An adverb of degree that modifies another adverb ("rapidement") is needed: "très rapidement". "Si" would need a "que" or a negation, "autant" and "beaucoup" cannot modify an adverb directly. Rule: très + adjective or adverb. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Docteur, doit-on consommer ____ viande régulièrement pour être en bonne santé ?
questions.corrige_markdown: "Consommer" with an unspecified quantity of an uncountable noun needs the partitive article: "de la viande" (feminine singular). "Une viande" means one kind of meat, "de" alone is used after a negation or a quantity word, and "la viande" alone is a generalisation without partitive sense. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: La Covid-19 sévit dans le monde entier au même moment ; c’est donc une ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: A disease that spreads over the whole world at the same time is a "pandémie". An "épidémie" is limited to a region or a country, an "endémie" is a disease permanently present in a region, and "maladie" is only the general word. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: As-tu fait tes tâches ménagères avant d’aller à l’école ? Moi, je n’ai pas pu faire ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The pronoun replaces "mes tâches ménagères" (feminine plural), so the possessive pronoun is "les miennes". "La mienne" is singular, "les miens" is masculine plural, and "des miennes" is not a possessive pronoun in this use. Rule: le mien, la mienne, les miens, les miennes. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Ma sœur Epossi s’est ____ un ordinateur portable.
questions.corrige_markdown: With a pronominal verb the auxiliary is être, but "se" is an indirect object (she bought something for herself) and the direct object "un ordinateur portable" comes after the verb, so the past participle stays invariable: "acheté". "Achetée" would be right only if the direct object came before the verb. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Cette femme de ménage est paresseuse. Elle travaille toujours ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: A manner complement is expressed by the gerund. The verb is pronominal (se plaindre), so the reflexive pronoun stays: "en se plaignant". "En plaignant" would mean pitying someone, and "en plaignante" does not exist. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: ____ que ma grand-mère est rentrée au village, nous ne cessons de penser à ses histoires drôles.
questions.corrige_markdown: The sentence expresses a point in time from which a continuing action starts: "depuis que". "Tandis que" expresses simultaneity or opposition, "bien que" needs the subjunctive and expresses concession, "enfin" cannot be followed by "que". **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Le ____ est l’outil de communication le plus utilisé dans plusieurs villages africains.
questions.corrige_markdown: The traditional African means of sending messages over a distance is the "tamtam" (talking drum). The violin and the balafon (xylophone) are musical instruments not used to send messages. "Tambour" is a general word for a drum, but "tamtam" is the term used for the African drum of communication. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire
O Level SBE French - civilisation et culture

questions.enonce_markdown: Pour réussir à mes examens, il faut que je ____ plus assidu à l’école.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Il faut que" is followed by the subjunctive; the first person singular of the present subjunctive of être is "que je sois". "Soit" is the third person, "serai" is future and "serais" is conditional. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Si nous partageons cette papaye entre nous trois, chacun en aura ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Dividing something into three equal parts gives "le tiers" (one third). "Un troisième" and "une troisième" are ordinals (third in a series), and "la tierce" is not used for a fraction. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: Avant, mon oncle allait toujours en voiture. Maintenant qu’il est en surpoids, il ira ____ à pied.
questions.corrige_markdown: The sentence opposes the past habit ("avant") to the future ("il ira"), so the adverb must mean "from now on": "dorénavant". "Autrefois" refers to the past, "toujours" would repeat the old habit, and "tantôt" means "sometimes" or "this afternoon". **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: “You need a mortgage of some of your property to be able to buy this house.” Dans cette phrase « mortgage » se traduit en français par ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: A mortgage on one's property, used as a guarantee for a loan, is an "hypothèque". "Crédit" is a loan in general, "location" and "bail" relate to renting. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais

questions.enonce_markdown: “It is two meters wide” se traduit en français par : Cela fait deux mètres ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: For the dimension the usual French construction is "deux mètres de large" (adjective used as a noun after de), the counterpart of "two metres wide". "En largeur" and "en large" are wrong prepositions. "De largeur" is also acceptable in careful French, but "de large" is the form that translates "wide" directly. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais

questions.enonce_markdown: “To be as hungry as a horse” se traduit en français par ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: An idiom must be translated by the equivalent idiom, not word for word: the French equivalent of "as hungry as a horse" is "avoir une faim de loup". The other options translate the image literally (horse) or change the expression. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais
O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: Dans une pièce de théâtre il y a essentiellement des ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: A play is made of the lines spoken by the characters, that is dialogues (with stage directions). Paragraphs, poems and narratives belong to other genres. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - litterature

*N’éveillez pas*  
*Le chat qui dort,*  
*Ni cet enfant*

*par un soupir*

*Un faible point*  
*Cherchent au loin*  
*Un lent sommeil.*

Cet extrait est écrit en ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The poem is made of three groups of five lines each (a stanza of five lines is a "quintil"). A tercet has three lines, a quatrain four and a distich two. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - comprehension de texte

questions.enonce_markdown:
(Texte des questions 19 et 20 ci-dessus.)

Les ____ constituent la structure de l’extrait ci-dessus.
questions.corrige_markdown: Counting the syllables line by line (mute e before a consonant is pronounced, mute e before a vowel is elided): N'é-veil-lez pas (4), Le chat qui dort (4), Ni cet en-fant (4), Qui guet-t'en-co-re (4), Le bruit des pas (4), and the same count holds for every other line, e.g. Plus dou-ce-ment (4), Ses yeux où veil-le (4). All lines have four syllables, so they are "quadrisyllabes". **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - comprehension de texte

questions.enonce_markdown:
**EDUCATION A LA CITOYENNETE ET A LA MORALE**

Le sceau de la République du Cameroun rend un acte ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The seal of the Republic is affixed to documents to authenticate them: it makes an act "authentique" (genuine, proved to come from the State). "Légal" and "crédible" do not describe what a seal does. "Officiel" is close, but the function of a seal is authentication. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le siège de l’Union Africaine se trouve à ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The headquarters of the African Union are in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: La nation est reconnue à travers ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: A nation is defined by a community of people sharing a common history, territory and will to live together: "la communauté historique". Tribe, race and ethnic group describe a group of common origin or culture, not a nation. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

*Options as printed:* A) 1961   B) 1957   C) 1970   D) 1972

questions.enonce_markdown: ____ est l’engagement solennel du Président de la République nouvellement élu devant les institutions.
questions.corrige_markdown: The solemn commitment taken by a newly elected President before the institutions is the oath-taking: "la prestation de serment". The right of pardon is a presidential power, the electoral tour is part of the campaign, and the address to the nation is a speech. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le drapeau est ____ lorsque le pays subit un évènement triste.
questions.corrige_markdown: In national mourning the flag is flown at half-mast, which is expressed in French by "en berne". "Hissé sur le mât" is the normal position, "descendu du mât" and "rangé" mean the flag is removed. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le parlement camerounais tient ____ sessions ordinaires annuelles.
questions.corrige_markdown: The Parliament of Cameroon meets in three ordinary sessions a year (March, June and November). **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: L’organe chargé de constater et de combattre la corruption est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (CONAC) is the body in charge of observing and fighting corruption. ELECAM organises elections and FEICOM finances councils. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le franc de la communauté financière africaine est utilisé dans ____ pays de l’Afrique centrale et occidentale.
questions.corrige_markdown: The CFA franc is used in fourteen countries: eight in the West African monetary union and six in Central Africa (CEMAC). **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: L’investissement étranger peut être découragé par ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Foreign investors need stability and legal security: unstable institutions discourage them. The absence of trade unions or of GICs (common initiative groups) and heavy rain are not the logical cause. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: ____ est un gaz à effet de serre qui contribue au réchauffement de la planète.
questions.corrige_markdown: Carbon dioxide ("gaz carbonique") is the main greenhouse gas produced by human activity and the one taught as the cause of global warming. Hydrogen is not a greenhouse gas and factory smoke is a mixture of particles, not a gas. Chlorofluorocarbons are also greenhouse gases, but they are mainly known for destroying the ozone layer. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le Mouvement International de la Croix Rouge a adopté les conventions de Genève en ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The four Geneva Conventions were adopted in 1949 (the first convention dates from 1864). **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Du 30 septembre au 04 octobre 2019, ____ a été organisé(e) au Cameroun.
questions.corrige_markdown: The Major National Dialogue ("Grand Dialogue National") took place from 30 September to 4 October 2019. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Pour juger les citoyens coupables de crimes économiques, le gouvernement crée le Tribunal ____ en 2012.
questions.corrige_markdown: The Special Criminal Court ("Tribunal Criminel Spécial") was created to try embezzlement of public funds of a high amount. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Les ____ assurent la défense des intérêts des ouvriers et des patrons.
questions.corrige_markdown: Trade unions ("syndicats") defend the interests of workers and employers. Political parties seek power, cooperatives produce or sell together. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: ____ est un élément de gymnastique.

questions.enonce_markdown: Lors d’une compétition officielle de lancer du poids où trois athlètes sont présents, un lanceur dispose de ____ secondes pour propulser l’engin.
questions.corrige_markdown: In the rules of athletics the time allowed for a trial depends on the number of athletes left: one minute when more than three remain, one minute thirty (90 seconds) when two or three remain. With three athletes: 90 seconds. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: ____ sont fixés sur les montants au saut en hauteur.
questions.corrige_markdown: The uprights of the high jump carry the supports on which the crossbar rests. Hurdles belong to hurdle races, and asymmetric and parallel bars are gymnastic apparatus. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Au 800m la ligne au-delà de laquelle les coureurs sont autorisés à changer de couloir pour se rapprocher de la corde est appelée ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: In the 800 m the runners start in lanes and may cut in to the inside after the "ligne de rabattement" (break line). The "ligne de décalage" is the staggered start line, the "lice" is the inner kerb. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Les lignes de prolongement du cercle de lancer du poids mesurent ____ mètres.

questions.enonce_markdown: L’écart minimum qui doit exister entre le sommet des montants et la hauteur maximale de la barre est de ____ centimètres.

questions.enonce_markdown:
____ est un justaucorps qui est une pièce qui recouvre les jambes (des hanches aux chevilles) et qui est régulièrement portée par les femmes en gymnastique au sol.

*Options as printed:* A) Un léotard   B) Un marcel   C) Une manique   D) Un académique
questions.corrige_markdown:
Marcel (a sleeveless vest) and manique (an oven glove or hand guard) are clearly wrong. The choice between "léotard" (a leotard, which normally leaves the legs free) and "académique" (a longer gymnastic suit) depends on the vocabulary of the Cameroonian physical education syllabus, which is not available here; "un académique" is the more probable key, but it could not be confirmed.

The printed question could not be keyed with enough certainty, so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.

questions.enonce_markdown:
La ligne de départ du 200 mètres est située au début ____.

*Options as printed:* A) de la deuxième ligne droite   B) du deuxième virage   C) du premier virage   D) de la première ligne droite
questions.corrige_markdown:
On a 400 m track the 400 m starts on the finish line and runs the first bend, then the back straight, then the second bend and the finishing straight. The 200 m starts at the beginning of the second bend and ends on the finishing straight. Counting the bends from the 400 m start line, the key would be "du deuxième virage", but the numbering convention of the paper is not stated, so this is not certain.

The printed question could not be keyed with enough certainty, so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive
